captured_note: Ported from the capture's self-contained methods/30_aim, specifically its Step-1 'As-is SSL comparison' (train_step1_pretrained.py, evaluate_linear_probe.py, configs/step1_pretrained.yaml). The capture's step 1 loads the official pre-trained AIM-600M backbone from HuggingFace via Apple's ml-aim package (aim-600M-2B-imgs) and linear-probes it, because the from-scratch pretraining data (DFN-2B+, ~2B uncurated images) is not public. That from-scratch autoregressive SSL path is the capture's excluded step. So this is an eval-only port, the AIM sibling of 28_dinov2 / 36_franca. The capture's own from-scratch step 2 (models/aim_vit.py) is not ported. The port keeps the capture directory numbering (30) per the 2026-08-09 keep-capture-numbering decision (this list's number 32 is AIM -- see docs/PORTING_ROADMAP.md).

upstream.note: Apple's official `aim` package (the aim-v1 subdirectory), the AIM ViT definition. Pinned as the submodule third_party/ml-aim and imported through PYTHONPATH (never copied into this repository or installed). Its own dependency huggingface_hub is in the lock; the model itself is not vendored. The backbone is built from AIM-600M's dims via ml-aim's `_aim` (verified: the official checkpoint below loads with 0 missing, 0 unexpected on the backbone; only the unused attentive-probe head is absent).

licence_note: The AIM code (apple/ml-aim) and the AIM-600M weights (apple/AIM on HuggingFace) are released by Apple under the Apple ML Research License (apple-amlr), which permits use, reproduction and modification for NON-COMMERCIAL research purposes only. This port uses them solely for academic research. Nothing under apple-amlr is copied into this repository: the code is referenced as a pinned git submodule (third_party/ml-aim) and the weights are a hash-pinned download that CI never fetches. This port's own files (adapter, evaluate, configs, tests) are original and carry this repository's licence; they only reference the Apple artifacts, they do not include them.
scope: The eval-only step is ported: freeze the official pretrained AIM-600M (ViT-H/14, embed_dim 1536, 24 blocks, 12 heads, patch 14; pretrained on DFN-2B+) and fit a linear probe on its frozen features -- the average of the last 6 transformer blocks, mean-pooled over patch tokens. The backbone is built from AIM-600M's dims via the pinned upstream (ml-aim's `_aim`) and the official backbone checkpoint is loaded strict (0 missing, 0 unexpected; only the attentive-probe head, which this port does not use, is absent). The from-scratch autoregressive pretraining on the unavailable DFN-2B+ (the capture's step 2 as well) is EXCLUDED, as in every port's step 2.
encoder: There is no encoder.pt: this port trains nothing. The representation is the official pretrained AIM-600M backbone, fetched as a hash-pinned download (backbone_artifact below), not produced here.
linear_eval: Probes AIM-600M's frozen features (the last-6-block average, patch mean-pooled), a genuine SSL representation, so the number is comparable (the capture's 'As-is SSL comparison', like 28_dinov2 / 36_franca). A real run needs the official backbone checkpoint (backbone_artifact below, fetched and hash-verified by bin/fetch-weights.py --artifact backbone_artifact, passed as the config's train.ckpt); the hermetic smoke leaves ckpt empty and builds a random tiny AIM (a few small blocks) at a tiny resolution, so nothing is downloaded and only the pipeline is exercised. Images use resize + centre crop + ImageNet normalisation; the probe follows the lab's shared ARSSL protocol (mean-centre + L2-normalise features, single linear layer, SGD momentum + cosine, top1/top5). See docs/EVAL_DOWNLOAD.md.

backbone_artifact.name: AIM-600M (ViT-H/14) DFN-2B+ pretrain backbone

backbone_artifact.sha256_source: measured on 2026-08-10 by a full download from huggingface.co/apple/AIM; bin/fetch-weights.py re-verifies this value on download. Not HTTP-gated (no login required).

rewritten_during_the_port: an eval-only port (linear_eval, no step 1); the from-scratch autoregressive pretraining on the unavailable DFN-2B+ is the capture's excluded step

the backbone is the pinned upstream (third_party/ml-aim), imported not copied; the capture installed ml-aim as a pip package and called aim.v1.utils.load_pretrained, which downloads from HuggingFace at call time -- this port pins the code (submodule) and the weights (a hash-pinned download named in backbone_artifact) instead, and builds the arch from AIM-600M's dims via ml-aim's `_aim` so the same file loads strict
the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA (the capture called .cuda())
features are extracted in fp32 (the capture used a float16 autocast, a GPU speed path with no meaningful effect on a frozen-feature linear probe)
the frozen feature is the average of the last num_feature_layers transformer blocks, mean-pooled over patch tokens (the capture's AIMBackboneWrapper hook average), kept faithfully

the probe follows the lab's shared ARSSL protocol (mean-centre + L2-normalise, single linear layer, SGD + cosine) rather than the capture's attentive-probe head, so the number is comparable across the ported methods (the attentive probe is reference-only in the capture)
the DistributedDataParallel / TensorBoard / tqdm machinery is dropped, single-process
